title: task complete on a Paused task fails with 'unconfigured status' and names neither the status nor the way out
description: Observed 2026-09-27 closing QCLI-388 on quest 0.11.0: `quest task complete` on a Paused record exits 6 with "Task transition uses an unconfigured status." Paused is configured (task status-flow reports pausedStatus "Paused"), so the message is wrong about the cause and gives no remedy. `task start` then `task complete` works. Whether complete should accept Paused directly is a design question and out of scope here. This task is only about the refusal naming the from-status and pointing to `quest task start <id>`.

acceptanceCriteria.text: task complete on a Paused task refuses with a message that names Paused as the current status and names quest task start <id> as the way back
A test covers the Paused-to-complete refusal text and exit code

finalSummary:
transitionTask (src/domain/tasks/tasks.ts) now tells a task sitting at the paused status, or at a retired paused literal, apart from a truly unconfigured status. For those it refuses with: Task <id> is "<status>", the paused status (or "a retired paused status"), which is off the status ladder. Bring it back with `quest task start <id>`, then retry. Any other off-ladder status keeps the old message. The refusal and exit 6 are unchanged. Whether complete should accept Paused directly stays out of scope, as the task says.

VERIFIED:
- AC1/AC2: test/qcli397-complete-paused-message.test.ts pauses T-1. `task complete T-1` then exits 6 with empty stdout and a validation error that contains 'T-1 is "Paused"' and "quest task start T-1" and no longer contains "unconfigured status". The record stays Paused. A second test shows that the named way out works (start, then complete, exit 0, Done). A third test shows that `task edit --status Done` on the paused task gets the same guidance, because both paths share transitionTask.
- Before the fix, tests 1 and 3 FAILED with the old message, and test 2 passed. After the fix, all 3 pass.
- bun run check: 887 pass, 0 fail, exit 0.
